data.title: 玛修 · 练习场的盾尖和粉笔线
data.description: 训练暂停后，玛修把大盾的底尖靠在粉笔线上，弯身把滚到脚边的训练标靶捡起来。顶灯压出黑曜胸甲的紫边和钢靴每一片活动甲。她重新摆正标靶，准备从同一个位置练下一组防守。
data.location: 迦勒底室内防护训练区
data.action: 把大盾底尖停在粉笔线上，一手扶盾，另一手收回掉落的训练标靶。
data.promptProse: Between repetitions, she sets the point of her large shield on a chalk line and stoops to pick up the practice target at her foot. Overhead light keeps both the chalk mark and the target in view.
data.animaCaption: The shield stays exactly on her starting line while she resets the target.
